principle_violations.reason: The VolumeCalculator is responsible for calculating volume but also inherits AreaCalculator, which manages area calculations. The main method also handles too many responsibilities including initializing different calculators and outputting results.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the responsibilities of area and volume calculations into dedicated classes or methods. Additionally, handle the initiation of calculators in a dedicated method.

principle_violations.reason: The current implementation tightly couples the VolumeCalculator with the AreaCalculator. If a new shape type needs to be added, the area calculation logic must be modified, violating the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Decouple the area and volume calculations using a common interface, allowing new types to be added without modifying existing classes.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details above.
